_comment: Ignition's OWN light and dark palettes, captured from a real 8.3.8
gateway (module-testing) on 2026-08-31 by resolving each theme's
var(--neutral-NN) chains against its served stylesheet.
Vendored because these two sheets live INSIDE the Perspective module,
not on disk, so a build machine with no gateway cannot read them -- the
same reason tools/sync-packs.sh vendors the source packs. They are used
only to draw the 'what every gateway starts with' preview; nothing is
installed from them and no theme depends on them.
Re-capture with insight/README.md's one-liner if IA changes its neutrals.
